**Extraction notes:**

- **Group A** is classified as `SI_plus_systemic_local_antimicrobial` — the treatment combined subgingival SRP (subgingival instrumentation) with systemic doxycycline 100 mg/day × 14 days prescribed to all subjects.
- **Group B** is classified as `usual_care` — explicitly described as "temporarily without periodontal treatment" / "non-treatment control group." They did also receive doxycycline (same dose), which the paper acknowledges may have produced some beneficial effect in the control group, but no active periodontal (subgingival) treatment was administered.
- Both arms had n=23 (confirmed in Table 1) and 16-week follow-up (assessment at 16 weeks post-treatment, per Table 3 and abstract).
